FDA ENFORCEMENT REPORT - FOOD
Recall number: F-2896-2026   Classification: Class I   Status: Ongoing
Recalling firm: Golden Crest Mushroom Co., Los Angeles, CA
Product description: Enoki mushrooms, 200 g (7.05 oz) clear plastic packages, product of Korea
Code information: Lot codes EN0826A and EN0826B, best-before dates through October 30, 2026
Reason for recall: Product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
Distribution pattern: Distributed to wholesalers and Asian specialty grocers in CA, NV and AZ.
Product quantity: 3,240 cases
Recall initiation date: 2026-09-11   Report date: 2026-09-22   Voluntary: Firm initiated
